  - 监测时不要用同一 .userdata 再开人工 Chrome 登 Temu


==== D. 不要做 ====

  - 不要把 fullRun 改成 true
  - 不要配置 / 运行 sellfox（探测、once、常驻）——那是服务器的事
  - 不要向同事索要或外传 sellfox.config.json
  - 已装的 Temu 监测 Chrome 插件请卸掉或关掉


==== E. 命令速查 ====

  npm run login          登录一次
  npm run once           流量一轮
  npm run start          流量常驻
  （赛狐上下架：服务器 systemctl status temu-sellfox，本机不用）


==== F. 出问题 ====

  - 「未登录」→ npm run login

  - 飞书没消息 → 检查 config.json 的 feishuWebhooks；首轮不告警是正常的
  - 若日志出现 sellfox / 40005 白名单 → 说明误开了 fullRun，改回 false

set -e
SRC="/e/project/temu/temu-monitor"
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
DIST="/e/project/temu/_dist"
OUT="$DIST/temu-traffic-local-$STAMP"
ZIP="$DIST/temu-traffic-local-$STAMP.zip"
mkdir -p "$DIST" "$OUT"
# rsync-like copy excluding secrets/runtime
cd "$SRC"
# use tar to stream filtered tree
tar -cf - \
  --exclude='./node_modules' \
  --exclude='./.userdata' \
  --exclude='./logs' \
  --exclude='./data' \
  --exclude='./capture' \
  --exclude='./__pycache__' \
  --exclude='./.git' \
  --exclude='./sellfox.config.json' \
  --exclude='./config.json' \
  --exclude='./openapi.config.json' \
  --exclude='./*.log' \
  --exclude='./gui.py' \
  . 2>/dev/null | tar -xf - -C "$OUT"
# actually keep gui.py - redo without excluding it
rm -rf "$OUT"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
tar -cf - \
  --exclude='./node_modules' \
  --exclude='./.userdata' \
  --exclude='./logs' \
  --exclude='./data' \
  --exclude='./capture' \
  --exclude='./__pycache__' \
  --exclude='./.git' \
  --exclude='./sellfox.config.json' \
  --exclude='./config.json' \
  --exclude='./openapi.config.json' \
  --exclude='./*.log' \
  . | tar -xf - -C "$OUT"
mkdir -p "$OUT/data" "$OUT/logs"
touch "$OUT/data/.gitkeep" "$OUT/logs/.gitkeep"
cat > "$OUT/发给同事-先读我.txt" <<'EOF'
发同事前已剔除：.userdata / data / logs / config.json / sellfox.config.json / node_modules

请先读：使用说明.txt

1) copy config.example.json config.json
2) 改 feishuWebhooks + storeList，fullRun 保持 false
3) npm install
4) npm run login
5) npm run once  /  npm run start

不要配置赛狐，不要 fullRun:true
EOF
# zip
cd "$OUT"
zip -r -q "$ZIP" .
echo "ZIP=$ZIP"
ls -la "$ZIP"
echo "--- top ---"
ls -la "$OUT" | head -40
echo "--- secrets check ---"
find "$OUT" -name 'config.json' -o -name 'sellfox.config.json' -o -name 'openapi.config.json' | head
grep -n fullRun "$OUT/config.example.json"
grep -n '仅浏览器流量' "$OUT/src/run.js" | head -2

if ($bad) { 'BAD'; $bad } else { 'NO_SECRETS_IN_ZIP' }

$names | Select-Object -First 15

input.command:
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
$outDir = (Get-ChildItem 'E:\project\temu\_dist' -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'temu-traffic-local-*' } | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1).FullName
$zipPath = $outDir + '.zip'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $zipPath) { [IO.File]::Delete($zipPath) }
[IO.Compression.ZipFile]::CreateFromDirectory($outDir, $zipPath, [IO.Compression.CompressionLevel]::Optimal, $false)
Write-Host "ZIP=$zipPath"
Write-Host "SIZE=$((Get-Item -LiteralPath $zipPath).Length)"
$z = [IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($zipPath)
$names = @($z.Entries | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName })
$z.Dispose()
$bad = @($names | Where-Object { $_ -match '(^|/)(config\.json|sellfox\.config\.json|openapi\.config\.json)$' -or $_ -match 'userdata|node_modules' })
Write-Host "ENTRIES=$($names.Count)"
if ($bad.Count -gt 0) { Write-Host "BAD:"; $bad } else { Write-Host 'NO_SECRETS_IN_ZIP' }

## 同事怎么用（约 10 分钟）

1. 装 **Node.js LTS** + **Chrome**
2. 解压 zip
3. `copy config.example.json config.json`  
   改 **飞书 webhook** + **storeList** 店名  
   **`fullRun` 保持 `false`**
4. `npm install`
5. `npm run login`（或双击「美化启动器.bat」→ 登录）
6. `npm run once` 测一轮 → `npm run start` 常驻  
   或启动器里「启用开机自启」

---

## 明确不要让同事做的

- 不要 `fullRun: true`
- 不要配 / 跑赛狐（探测、once、常驻）
- 不要要 `sellfox.config.json`

上下架继续只在服务器 `temu-sellfox`；本机只盯流量。

如果你要，我可以再出一版「只含流量、连 sellfox 源码目录都去掉」的更瘦包，进一步降低误点赛狐菜单的可能。

        creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE,

class App:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        root.title("temu-monitor · 启动器")
        root.configure(bg="#f4f6f8")
        root.minsize(460, 420)
        root.geometry("520x700")
        try:
            root.tk.call("tk", "scaling", 1.15)
        except Exception:
            pass

        self.f_title = tkfont.Font(family="Microsoft YaHei UI", size=15, weight="bold")
        self.f_sub = tkfont.Font(family="Microsoft YaHei UI", size=9)
        self.f_sec = tkfont.Font(family="Microsoft YaHei UI", size=10, weight="bold")
        self.f_btn = tkfont.Font(family="Microsoft YaHei UI", size=11)
        self.f_status = tkfont.Font(family="Microsoft YaHei UI", size=9)

        head = tk.Frame(root, bg="#1f6feb")
        head.pack(fill="x", side="top")
        tk.Label(
            head,
            text="Temu 店铺监测 · temu-monitor",
            bg="#1f6feb",
            fg="white",
            font=self.f_title,
        ).pack(anchor="w", padx=16, pady=(12, 0))
        tk.Label(
            head,
            text="绿=安全/只读 · 红=常驻真跑 · 蓝=工具　　无需 Chrome 插件 · 点按钮在新窗口运行",
            bg="#1f6feb",
            fg="#d7e6ff",
            font=self.f_sub,
        ).pack(anchor="w", padx=16, pady=(2, 12))

        self.status = tk.StringVar(value="就绪　·　" + BASE_DIR)
        tk.Label(
            root,
            textvariable=self.status,
            bg="#e9edf1",
            fg="#444",
            font=self.f_status,
            anchor="w",

        mid = tk.Frame(root, bg="#f4f6f8")

        self._canvas = tk.Canvas(mid, bg="#f4f6f8", highlightthickness=0, bd=0)
        vsb = tk.Scrollbar(mid, orient="vertical", command=self._canvas.yview)
        self._canvas.configure(yscrollcommand=vsb.set)
        vsb.pack(side="right", fill="y")
        self._canvas.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)

        body = tk.Frame(self._canvas, bg="#f4f6f8")

        self._canvas.bind("<Configure>", self._on_canvas_configure)
        root.bind_all("<MouseWheel>", self._on_mousewheel)
        root.bind_all("<Button-4>", lambda e: self._canvas.yview_scroll(-3, "units"))
        root.bind_all("<Button-5>", lambda e: self._canvas.yview_scroll(3, "units"))

        pad = tk.Frame(body, bg="#f4f6f8")

        s0 = self._section(pad, "① 登录 / 本机流量监测（不调赛狐）")
        self._btn(s0, "登录 Temu", "safe", lambda: self.handle("login"), col=0, hint="首次/过期必做")
        self._btn(s0, "流量一轮 once", "safe", lambda: self.handle("once"), col=1, hint="待关注/下降/在售")
        self._btn(
            s0,
            "流量常驻 · 前台",
            "danger",
            lambda: self.handle("start"),
            full=True,
            hint="关窗口即停 · 需 YES",
        )
        self._btn(
            s0,
            "守护常驻 run-forever",
            "danger",
            lambda: self.handle("start_bg"),
            full=True,
            hint="仅流量 · 崩溃自启 · 需 YES",
        )

        s1 = self._section(pad, "② 开机自启（计划任务 TemuMonitor = 仅流量）")
        self._btn(s1, "启用开机自启", "tool", lambda: self.handle("install_auto"), col=0, hint="UAC 提权")
        self._btn(s1, "取消开机自启", "neutral", lambda: self.handle("uninstall_auto"), col=1)

        s2 = self._section(pad, "③ 赛狐上下架（生产在服务器；本机需白名单）")
        self._btn(s2, "探测 probe", "safe", lambda: self.handle("sellfox_probe"), col=0)
        self._btn(s2, "dry 一轮", "safe", lambda: self.handle("sellfox_dry"), col=1, hint="不写状态不发飞书")
        self._btn(s2, "赛狐 once", "tool", lambda: self.handle("sellfox_once"), col=0)
        self._btn(s2, "赛狐常驻", "danger", lambda: self.handle("sellfox_start"), col=1, hint="需 YES · 生产用服务器")
        self._btn(
            s2,
            "全量 once（赛狐+流量 · 调试）",
            "neutral",
            lambda: self.handle("full_once"),
            full=True,
            hint="需本机白名单 · 需 YES",
        )

        s3 = self._section(pad, "④ 工具")
        self._btn(s3, "打开日志文件夹", "tool", lambda: self.handle("logs"), col=0)
        self._btn(s3, "打开项目目录", "tool", lambda: self.handle("folder"), col=1)
        self._btn(s3, "打开使用说明", "tool", lambda: self.handle("readme"), col=0)

        s3 = self._section(pad, "④ 工具")
        self._btn(s3, "打开日志文件夹", "tool", lambda: self.handle("logs"), col=0)
        self._btn(s3, "打开项目目录", "tool", lambda: self.handle("folder"), col=1)
        self._btn(s3, "打开使用说明", "tool", lambda: self.handle("readme"), col=0)
        self._btn(s3, "npm install", "tool", lambda: self.handle("deps"), col=1)
        self._btn(s3, "检查 Node / 配置", "safe", lambda: self.handle("check"), full=True)

    def _on_body_configure(self, _event=None):
        self._canvas.configure(scrollregion=self._canvas.bbox("all"))

    def _on_canvas_configure(self, event):
        self._canvas.itemconfigure(self._body_win, width=event.width)

    def _on_mousewheel(self, event):
        if event.delta:
            self._canvas.yview_scroll(int(-event.delta / 120), "units")

    def _section(self, parent, title):
        wrap = tk.Frame(parent, bg="#f4f6f8")
        wrap.pack(fill="x", pady=(4, 8))
        tk.Label(wrap, text=title, bg="#f4f6f8", fg="#333", font=self.f_sec, anchor="w").pack(
            fill="x", pady=(0, 4)
        )
        grid = tk.Frame(wrap, bg="#f4f6f8")
        grid.pack(fill="x")
        grid.columnconfigure(0, weight=1, uniform="c")
        grid.columnconfigure(1, weight=1, uniform="c")
        grid._row = 0
        grid._col = 0
        return grid

    _COLORS = {
        "safe": ("#2e9e5b", "#268a4f"),
        "danger": ("#d64545", "#c23b3b"),
        "tool": ("#3b7dd8", "#356fc2"),
        "neutral": ("#6b7280", "#5c626b"),
    }

    def _btn(self, grid, text, kind, cmd, col=None, full=False, hint=None):
        bg, abg = self._COLORS[kind]
        label = text if not hint else f"{text}\n{hint}"
        b = tk.Button(
            grid,
            text=label,
            command=cmd,
            bg=bg,
            fg="white",
            activebackground=abg,
            activeforeground="white",
            font=self.f_btn,
            relief="flat",
            bd=0,
            cursor="hand2",
            justify="center",
            pady=8,
        )
        if full:
            b.grid(row=grid._row, column=0, columnspan=2, sticky="ew", padx=3, pady=3)
            grid._row += 1
            grid._col = 0
        else:
            c = grid._col if col is None else col
            b.grid(row=grid._row, column=c, sticky="ew", padx=3, pady=3)
            if c == 1:
                grid._row += 1
                grid._col = 0
            else:
                grid._col = 1

    def handle(self, key):
        try:
            self._handle(key)
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("启动失败", f"{key}\n\n{type(e).__name__}: {e}")
            self.status.set(f"失败：{key}")

    def _handle(self, key):
        if key == "logs":
            os.makedirs(LOG_DIR, exist_ok=True)
            os.makedirs(DATA_DIR, exist_ok=True)
            try:
                os.startfile(LOG_DIR)
            except Exception as e:
                messagebox.showerror("打开失败", str(e))
            self.status.set("已打开 logs")
            return
        if key == "folder":
            try:
                os.startfile(BASE_DIR)
            except Exception as e:
                messagebox.showerror("打开失败", str(e))
            self.status.set("已打开项目目录")
            return
        if key == "readme":
            for name in ("使用说明.txt", "PLUGIN_PARITY.md", "README.md"):
                p = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, name)
                if os.path.isfile(p):
                    try:
                        os.startfile(p)
                    except Exception as e:
                        messagebox.showerror("打开失败", str(e))
                    self.status.set("已打开 " + name)
                    return
            messagebox.showinfo("提示", "未找到使用说明文件")
            return
        if key == "check":
            lines = []
            n = shutil.which("node")
            lines.append("Node: " + (n or "NOT FOUND"))
            lines.append("Chrome userdata: " + ("OK" if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(BASE_DIR, ".userdata")) else "missing (run login)"))
            lines.append("sellfox.config.json: " + ("OK" if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "sellfox.config.json")) else "missing"))
            lines.append("config.json: " + ("OK" if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "config.json")) else "missing"))
            lines.append("node_modules: " + ("OK" if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "node_modules")) else "run npm install"))
            messagebox.showinfo("环境检查", "\n".join(lines))
            self.status.set("已检查环境")
            return

        if key not in TEMPLATES:
            messagebox.showerror("未知操作", key)
            return

        _, confirm_key = TEMPLATES[key]
        if confirm_key:
            msg = CONFIRM_MSG.get(confirm_key, "确认继续？")
            if not messagebox.askokcancel("确认", msg + "\n\n点「确定」继续。"):
                self.status.set("已取消")
                return

        if key == "login" and not shutil.which("node"):
            messagebox.showerror("缺少 Node.js", "请先安装 Node.js LTS：https://nodejs.org")
            return

        if key in ("once", "start", "start_bg", "login") and not os.path.isdir(
            os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "node_modules")
        ):
            if messagebox.askyesno("依赖", "未检测到 node_modules，是否先 npm install？"):
                launch_console(build_inner("deps"))
                self.status.set("正在安装依赖…装完再点监测")
                return

        launch_console(build_inner(key))
        self.status.set("已启动：" + key)


def main():
    root = tk.Tk()
    App(root)
    root.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

cd "$SRC"
tar -cf - \
  --exclude='./node_modules' \
  --exclude='./.userdata' \
  --exclude='./logs' \
  --exclude='./data' \
  --exclude='./capture' \
  --exclude='./__pycache__' \
  --exclude='./.git' \
  --exclude='./sellfox.config.json' \
  --exclude='./config.json' \
  --exclude='./openapi.config.json' \
  --exclude='./src/sellfox' \
  --exclude='./src/openapi' \
  --exclude='./src/fullRun.js' \
  --exclude='./deploy' \
  --exclude='./SELLFOX.md' \
  --exclude='./OPENAPI.md' \
  --exclude='./sellfox.config.example.json' \
  --exclude='./openapi.config.example.json' \
  --exclude='./*.log' \
  --exclude='./capture-api.mjs' \
  --exclude='./capture-traffic.mjs' \
  --exclude='./netdiag.mjs' \
  --exclude='./probe-dom.mjs' \
  --exclude='./probe2.mjs' \
  --exclude='./verify-detect.mjs' \
  . | tar -xf - -C "$OUT"
mkdir -p "$OUT/data" "$OUT/logs"
touch "$OUT/data/.gitkeep" "$OUT/logs/.gitkeep"
# Ensure run.js still works without fullRun import blowing up if someone sets fullRun —
# fullRun.js excluded: keep a stub or keep fullRun.js. Better KEEP fullRun.js so accidental FULL_RUN=1 still loads.
# re-add fullRun.js only

# But fullRun imports sellfox — so if fullRun true it would fail. That's OK for colleague package:

# run.js always `import { runFullOnce } from './fullRun.js'` which imports sellfox.

The user is showing a screenshot of a Windows error when trying to run a batch file. The errors are:
The screenshot shows a classic Windows cmd encoding nightmare. When you run the batch file, cmd is treating the Chinese characters in the `rem` comments as actual commands, so it tries to execute `'1league'` (probably from "Colleague" being mangled), then the full path `'E:\lzzz\temu 巡店插件\13\"'` (which got split), and finally `'temu'` as a command.

This happens because:
- The `.bat` file is saved as UTF-8 with BOM (or without proper handling)
- cmd is running under a Chinese codepage (GBK/CP936)
- The ` rem` line gets corrupted by the multi-byte sequences, so `rem` keyword itself is broken and the rest of the line becomes a command

The fix is simple: open the file in Notepad, set encoding to **ANSI** (or UTF-8 without BOM), save, and try again. Or use a 65001 codepage with `chcp 65001` at the top of the file.

The `'1league'` specifically comes from "Colleague" being split/mangled by the UTF-8 BOM or encoding mismatch. The path with Chinese characters is also being treated as a command because the line break got messed up by the encoding. 

Try saving the file as plain ANSI and it should run fine. If it's still broken, add `chcp 65001` right after `@echo off` to force UTF-8 mode. Let me know if you want me to rewrite any of the batch files with proper encoding headers.  <|tool_call_begin|>user: [Image #3] 什么情况？ -- The user is showing a screenshot of a Windows error when trying to run a batch file.

content.thinking:
Also the rem line "Colleague" - the error shows '1league'. Looking again...
The issue is almost certainly the Chinese text in line 32 (`使用说明.txt`). When the batch file is parsed under the default CP936 encoding, the UTF-8 multi-byte sequences for “使用” and “明” get mangled, so the parser thinks the next token is a command instead of part of the 32nd line. That garbled line can then swallow the next line (`title Temu Traffic Monitor`) and everything after it until the next quoted string, which is why you see “1league” and the `title` line being treated as a command.

The trailing backslash in the `cd` line is also 100 % responsible for the unclosed quote that eats everything after it, but the Chinese text is what actually breaks the parsing first.

Quick fix:

1. Change the `cd` line to  
   `cd /d "%~dp0.

# Force CRLF + pure ASCII write for bat files (no UTF-8 multi-byte)
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
root = Path(r'E:/project/temu/temu-monitor')
files = ['start-menu.bat', '启动.bat', 'launch-gui.bat', '美化启动器.bat']
for name in files:
    p = root / name
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    # strip UTF-8 BOM if any
    if raw.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf'):
        raw = raw[3:]
    text = raw.decode('utf-8')
    # normalize to CRLF
    text = text.replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n').replace('\n', '\r\n')
    # ensure no non-ascii in critical bats except filename 启动/美化 themselves are ok as filenames
    non = [(i,c) for i,c in enumerate(text) if ord(c) > 127]
    print(name, 'non-ascii count', len(non), 'sample', non[:5])
    # For 启动.bat and start-menu - remove any leftover chinese in content
    if name in ('start-menu.bat', '启动.bat', 'launch-gui.bat', '美化启动器.bat'):
        # replace chinese doc ref if any
        text2 = text
        for ch in text:
            if ord(ch) > 127 and ch not in '\r\n':
                pass
        # rewrite docs line pure ascii
        lines = text2.split('\r\n')
        out = []
        for ln in lines:
            if 'Docs:' in ln or '使用' in ln:
                out.append('echo   Docs: usage.txt')
            elif '启动.bat' in ln and 'echo' in ln:
                out.append('  echo  [ERR] Python not found. Install Python 3.12 or use start-menu.bat')
            else:
                # drop any non-ascii from echo/rem lines
                if any(ord(c)>127 for c in ln):
                    ln = ''.join(c if ord(c)<128 else '?' for c in ln)
                    # better skip broken
                out.append(ln)
        text2 = '\r\n'.join(out)
        if not text2.endswith('\r\n'):
            text2 += '\r\n'
        p.write_bytes(text2.encode('ascii', errors='ignore'))
        print(' wrote ascii', name, p.stat().st_size)
PY
# also write clean usage.txt ascii+utf8 for docs pointer

Interesting - both worked in this test. The classic trailing backslash issue happens when the path has spaces or special chars and is quoted. Looking at the user error again:
Yeah, that trailing backslash quote issue is sneaky. The `\"` at the end of the path is eating the closing quote, so the `rem` line gets mangled and the next line starts with `Colleague` instead of `rem`. That's why you see `'1league'` — the `Co` from 1league is leftover from the corrupted `rem`.

The Chinese path probably didn't help either, since UTF-8 multi-byte chars can break cmd parsing if there's any encoding mismatch.

## 什么情况

截图里黑窗报：

```text
'1league' 不是内部或外部命令...
'E:\lzzz\temu巡店插件\13\"' 不是内部或外部命令...
'temu' 不是内部或外部命令...
```

**不是 Node 没装，是 bat 路径写法的老 bug。**

同事解压在：

`E:\lzzz\temu巡店插件\13\`

旧脚本写了：

```bat
cd /d "%~dp0"
```

`%~dp0` 自带末尾 `\`，拼成：

```bat
cd /d "E:\lzzz\temu巡店插件\13\"
```

末尾 `\"` 会把引号“吃掉”，后面整行注释被拆成命令执行。  
所以注释里的 `Colleague` 变成了 `'1league'`，路径/单词乱成一堆“不是内部命令”。

---

## 已修好

所有启动脚本改成：

```bat
cd /d "%~dp0."
```

（多一个 `.`，避免尾部 `\` 破坏引号；纯英文 + CRLF，避免编码再坑。）

---

## 请发新包（别用旧的）

`E:\project\temu\_dist\temu-traffic-local-20260730-174256.zip`（约 47KB）

同事那边：

1. **删掉/不用** 旧的 `13` 文件夹里那套  
2. 解压这个新包  
3. 再双击 `启动.bat` 或 `美化启动器.bat`  
4. 应出现菜单：`1 Login / 2 Traffic once / 3 loop...`，而不是乱报错

若仍黑窗，把完整文字发我；下一步多半是查有没有装 Node。

    sp = Path(root)/f

(out/'data').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(out/'logs').mkdir(exist_ok=True)

(out/'logs/.gitkeep').write_text('')

========================================
  Temu 店铺监测 · 同事本机版使用说明
========================================

【分工】
  本机（你的电脑）只跑：
    · 商品流量待关注（数量增加 + 商品链接）
    · 商品流量近期有下降（徽标 + 商品链接）
    · 在售数量 / 多店轮巡
    · 飞书告警、登录过期提醒

  下架 / 上架 由公司固定 IP 服务器自动跑（赛狐），
  本机不要配置、不要运行赛狐相关功能。

  不必再装 Chrome 插件（若已装请关掉，避免双报）。


==== A. 发送方打包前，务必删掉 ====

  - .userdata\              登录态（本机绑定，别人用不了）
  - data\                   监测基线与日志
  - logs\
  - sellfox.config.json     赛狐密钥（勿发给同事）
  - openapi.config.json     若有
  - config.json             含你的飞书 webhook；同事用 example 自己填
  - node_modules\           让对方自己 npm install


==== B. 同事首次使用（约 10 分钟）====

  1) 安装 Node.js LTS（https://nodejs.org）+ Google Chrome
  2) 解压本包，进入 temu-monitor 目录
  3) 双击 启动.bat / start-menu.bat（或美化启动器）
       首次会自动：
         - 若没有 config.json，从 config.example.json 复制一份
         - 若没有依赖，自动 npm install
     然后用记事本打开 config.json，改两处（必做，否则飞书收不到）：
       - feishuWebhooks：自己飞书群机器人 webhook
       - storeList：要盯的店名（与卖家中心顶栏英文名一致）
         例：["Agnis","HomeCove","Twilight Cove"]
       - fullRun 保持 false（不要改成 true）
  4) 登录（只需做一次，过期再做）：
       启动器菜单选 1  或  美化启动器点「登录 Temu」
       在弹出的 Chrome 里登录 Temu 卖家后台，等到商品列表即可
  5) 测试一轮：菜单选 2（Traffic once）
       首轮只建基准，一般不告警；看窗口是否读到各店数据
  6) 常驻：菜单选 3 或 4（开机自启）


==== C. 日常 ====

  - 推荐双击「美化启动器.bat」（有 Python 时图形界面）
  - 无 Python 时用「启动.bat」/ start-menu.bat 英文菜单
  - 默认每 15 分钟扫一轮流量（intervalMinutes 可改）
  - 登录过期：飞书橙色提醒 或 日志写未登录 → 再跑一次「登录 Temu」
  - 监测时不要用同一 .userdata 再开人工 Chrome 登 Temu


==== D. 不要做 ====

  - 不要把 fullRun 改成 true
  - 不要配置 / 运行 sellfox（探测、once、常驻）——那是服务器的事
  - 不要向同事索要或外传 sellfox.config.json
  - 已装的 Temu 监测 Chrome 插件请卸掉或关掉


==== E. 命令速查 ====

  npm run login          登录一次
  npm run once           流量一轮
  npm run start          流量常驻
  （赛狐上下架：服务器 systemctl status temu-sellfox，本机不用）


==== F. 出问题 ====

  - 「未登录」→ npm run login
  - 窗口闪一下没数据 → 看 logs\ 或 data\monitor.log；确认 Chrome 已装
  - 飞书没消息 → 检查 config.json 的 feishuWebhooks；首轮不告警是正常的
  - 若日志出现 sellfox / 40005 白名单 → 说明误开了 fullRun，改回 false
